About

Description

Banksy is a pseudonymous England-based street artist, political activist, and film director whose real name and identity remain unconfirmed and the subject of speculation. Wikipedia
Born: 17 October 1974 (age 50 years), Bristol, United Kingdom
Spouse: Joy Millward (m. 2006)
Period: Street art
On view: Austin Museum of Popular Culture
Influenced by: Diana, Princess of Wales, Marcel Duchamp, Käthe Kollwitz
Film: Graffiti Wars
